title: You Lied to Us

body:
You told us you couldn’t.

 You swore that you wouldn’t.

 You said it was impossible

 To change that much that fast.

 You called the rest of us dreamers,

 Idealist, unrealistic.

 You laughed at us.

 Then, in a matter of days,

 You spent more to retrieve

 The unsustainable past

 Than we asked you to invest

 In a sustainable future.

 If you get your grasp on your

 Precious present

 Again, don’t lie to us again.

 We need your new realization:

 That when crisis hits,

 What seemed impossible

 And unthinkable

 Becomes inevitable

 And unavoidable

 Overnight.
